description: An effects expander for Tapestry, adding a bit crusher and a 24dB per octave resonant lowpass filter to its output; it goes immediately to the right of Tapestry

params.text: Sets the bit depth the crusher rounds the signal to: 16 bits fully right, 1 bit fully left
Sets how many samples the crusher holds each value for: one fully left, 64 fully right
Crossfades between Tapestry's audio and the bit-crushed version of it, with the crusher out of circuit fully left
Sets the filter cutoff on a logarithmic scale, 20Hz fully left to 20kHz fully right, and never above 45% of the sample rate
Sets the filter resonance, none fully left up to a feedback factor of nearly 4 fully right, trimmed back slightly as the cutoff rises
Crossfades between the bit crusher's output and the filtered version of it, with the filter out of circuit fully left
Sets the gain applied after both effects: silence fully left, unity at centre, twice fully right, after which the signal is soft-clipped and held inside ±1.5

inputs.text: Shifts the bit depth, 1V for one and a half bits; the total of knob and voltage is held between 1 and 16 bits
Shifts the sample hold length, 10V covering the whole of the RATE knob's travel; the total is held inside that travel
Shifts the bit crusher's dry-wet balance, 10V covering the whole of that knob's travel; the total is held inside that travel
Shifts the filter cutoff, 1V moving it by about an octave; the total of knob and voltage is held inside the knob's travel
Shifts the filter resonance, 10V covering the whole of the RES knob's travel; the total is held inside that travel
Shifts the filter's dry-wet balance, 10V covering the whole of that knob's travel; the total is held inside that travel

notes: with no Tapestry immediately to its left this module does nothing at all: it reads no audio, writes no audio and returns before any knob is read, and its green lamp stays dark
the processed audio is handed back to Tapestry and leaves through Tapestry's own output jacks, which is why this module has no output of its own
both dry-wet knobs come up fully left, so a freshly placed expander passes Tapestry's audio through with only a 20Hz DC blocker and the output gain applied
